description: This is a Java source file for an Android activity named MainActivity. It extends SampleActivityBase and manages a user interface that includes fragment transactions and menu options, as well as logging functionalities.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity manages the app's main screen, fragment initialization, menu interactions, and sets up logging for the user interface.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and adds the ElevationBasicFragment if no saved state exists.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu from the main menu resource.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares the menu, updating visibility and title of the log toggle menu item based on current state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, toggling log display in the UI.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up logging chain, wrapping Android's native log framework with custom filters and fragments for on-screen display.
